description: This source file contains test helper implementations for managing workflow executions, storage, and event buses in a testing context within the 'handlers' package.

classes.name: testExecutionStorage
classes.description: A mock storage implementation for testing workflow execution workflows, providing thread-safe methods to store, update, retrieve, and query workflow-related data.

methods.name: newTestExecutionStorage
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new instance of testExecutionStorage, initializing internal maps and event buses.

methods.name: GetAgent

methods.description: Stores a WorkflowExecution object in the storage and signals updates.

methods.name: UpdateWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Updates an existing WorkflowExecution using a provided update function.

methods.name: GetWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkflowExecution by its ID.

methods.name: GetWorkflowRun

methods.name: QueryWorkflowRuns
methods.description: Returns all WorkflowRuns matching specified filters.

methods.name: CountWorkflowRuns
methods.description: Counts the number of WorkflowRuns matching specified filters.

methods.name: StoreWorkflowStep
